args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## ANALYTICS & REPORTING FOR SERVICETORODUCTION
- **corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Generates diagnostic reports, analyzes incident patterns (service resolution), examines equipment status (maintenance patterns), links to change requests (change impact), recommends preventive measures (continuous improvement)

## COMPENSATION RESOURCES (Generic)
- **workday.hcm:agent:CompensationAdjustmentAutomation:v1** - Merit increases and compensation based on performance/tenure
- **sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1** - Policy-driven salary adjustments, employee lifecycle changes

## SERVICE REQUEST & ORDER CAPTURE
- **sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine** - Converts sales opportunities to customer orders
- **corp.itsm agents process ServiceTickets** - IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, IncidentSafetyCoordinator
- **sap.ariba** - Purchase Order Network API for procurement orders

## SUPPLY CHAIN RISK & COMPLIANCE
- **sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1** - Validates vendor safety certifications
- **sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1** - Supply chain risk mitigation
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - Material specs validation

## PRODUCTION MONITORING & INCIDENT ANALYSIS
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Analyzes SafetyIncident data, generates RCA reports
- **siemens.plm:agent:QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention:v1** - Monitors Machine/ProductionOrder/QualityInspection
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1** - Detects quality deviations

## WORKFORCE & RESOURCE ALLOCATION
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - Matches competencies to projects, NOT service ticket scheduling

## PRODUCT HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCE COMPLIANCE
- **sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1** - Automates safety validation across materials/product items, enforces compliance, validates BOM, detects safety risks & regulatory gaps, initiates remediation for hazardous substance compliance
